claim_boundary: V16 reconciles observables and proves a direct rational degree barrier. It does not construct a public sub-square-root evaluator, prove an unrestricted circuit lower bound, or give an ECDLP algorithm.
next_frontier: high-degree low-size or modular-composition sector evaluation
additive mixed-CM-weight outputs with nontrivial C3 covariance
representation-specific lower bounds stronger than degree alone
results: the V15 three-sign carry c is exactly the legacy GLV carry g_G
the Kummer sector is J_G=sigma(Q)g_G(Q), not the old R3_G observable
K_H factors exactly as K_{G,+}K_{G,-}, and J_G=2e_+-1 by CRT
the parity correlation S(a;n) has an exact two-floor-sum formula computable by Euclidean descent
the secp256k1 sector factor degrees are (n-1+208)/4 and (n-1-208)/4
any ordinary rational function directly returning field values J_G=+/-1 on the whole half-kernel has degree at least (n-1+208)/4
the lower bound has bit length 254 and is not an arithmetic-circuit lower bound
on all 438 frozen oriented roots the canonical sector representative has degree deg(K_H)-1
